newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air extends contracts with China Air.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air extends contracts with China Air.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc said on Monday it had extended its current two contracts with China Airlines.
The combined value of the contracts is about $150 million, the company said.

The company said that one existing five year contract has been extended from April 1998 to October 2001, and another existing three-year contract has been extended from March 1998 to February 2001 with an option to extend to 2003.
Atlas Air is a United States certified air carrier that operates a fleet of 747-200 aircraft.
